title: Removing the only key of a flow mapping leaves {} and keeps the key before it
notes: The mapping is in flow style with spaces inside the braces. Removing its only entry leaves an empty flow mapping, which reads back as an empty mapping; `a:` alone would read back as null. The spelling `{}` is the same as in `edit/remove-only-child-mapping-leaves-empty-mapping` for a block mapping, so the spaces inside the old braces go with the entry. `{ }` reads back the same and the specification allows the space, so the exact bytes `{}` rest on the kit convention that an emptied collection is written `{}` or `[]`.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend wrote `{ }` with a space; the pure backend wrote the expected bytes.
